title: Lockdown Update: What is going to happen again after 15 June Lockdown? , Off the record
description: Can the term of lockdown in the country grow once again due to the corona virus. A claim is being made on social media these days. For the past few days, a message has been going viral that from June 15, there will be a lockdown again across the country. In such a situation, know what is the truth of the lockdown after June 15, Pankaj Jha is telling the political editor of ABP News. #Lockdownupdate #Covid19 #AbpnewsHindi  Subscribe our channel: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMPHDQznmQL72WJ2WJ2UYINW5W?Sub_confirmation=1  About channel: ABP News is a news channel that provides the latest top news, sports, business, entertainment, politics and many other coverage. The channel mainly provides a detailed description of the latest news from different parts of India.  ABP News is a news hub which provides you with the comprehensive up-to-dete news coverage from all over India and world. asr.full_text: Hello! I am Pankaj Jha. There's another case being raised. That's the thing about the next lockdown. People keep trying to find it out from each other to see if there's a lock down coming. This is what has been happening all over the world, especially in Delhi and Mumbai. As you know, the things big and small towns… ..the situation gets worse. The number of corona patients is constantly growing. The hospitals are struggling in treating these people. No alleyway or society remains where there are no corona patients. People are scared. Doesn't know when, who's number will be shown. Unlock 1 has released everything since its opening. people are scared.. Don't know when or whose number will come In UnlockOne, shops all are open But the infection of corona has increased Delhi is in chaos and Mumbai is not able to walk Coronavirus was spread from China's Wuhan city If the situation remains the same But the real danger remains a lockdown in Mumbai can be started again This lockdown can be put off again in Mumbai. That's what udhav thackeray, Maharashtra's prime minister, said. He said this in Marathi. After a continuous consultation, Thackeray feels that these things won't be possible without the lockdown. Lockdown was removed to fix the economy but now things have started to bad. While in Mumbai, malls and temples and Mumbai aren't open yet and this is what's happening. The most number cases in India are in Maharashtra. The second case is Gujarat and the third is Delhi. The situation is out of control in Mumbai. The death rate here is close to 35.5%. I received some messages from some of the government officials in Maharashtra. All of them are saying the same thing. That the need for a lockdown in Mumbai is growing. Although I spoke to certain ministers of the State Government of India, they all said once and for all that lockdown is becoming an important step for Mumbai. It's CM Uddup Thackeray who needs to take the final decision. Even he is making up his mind According to the guidelines the Central Government has issued, no government can legislate a deal. But it has the right to be even more tough. That is the reason how the Thakere government can lock down Mumbai again. How long will it be locked down? Two weeks, one month or so, you could discuss later when the decision is to lock it down or not. But the Maharaj government is been thinking of doing something regarding this Now, going to Delhi Here too, situation is very bad Here, the number of people affected by the corona virus has increased to about 33,000 And the number of deaths has reached up to 1,000 Delhi's CM, Arvind Kejriwal In his own kind of rhetoric Has not stated clearly about the lockdown But, his statement is clearly evident He's also convinced, that the conditions are delicate in Delhi Like Dhanabha Thackray, it is not clear when the lockdown will take place but their message is being understood. They also believe that the circumstances are difficult in Delhi. The statistics of Delhi's government show such results that up to 1 lakh cases will be held until 30th June. As far as due to the increased cases, there are 318 cases from 9th till 10th July. Based on the pace of cases getting increased to a maximum of 55,000 cases will be held till,032,000 by 31 July. Again I'm telling you, the cases will reach to 5,032,000. This can mean that you need 6,000 by 21th and 1,100,000 by 21st. The situation is that there are only 6,000 beds available for COVID patients in Delhi. Now wonder what the circumstances would be But for the patients of Corona we have 6 000 beds in Delhi only. Now think about it, what might that be like if the Covid-19 infection continues the way it is like right now. Leave the beds, this won't be an option too! And there are such conditions too. From today, the hospital bed is no where less. People are forced to go around in different hospitals. There is no proper test for the Asymptomatic people can't get their tests done... ...for those who have symptoms of the corona virus. Such people cannot get tested very easily either. CM Arvind Kejriwal had said that... "...Delhi is starting to start getting safe". In such a situation what shall be done? Lockdown of the lockdown? Even though Kejriwal hasn't said anything... ...but their many senior officials want the same. They say that in 14 days of lockdown down for 14 days, more cases in India will appear, the sign of infection will be reduced which can be increased even for two more weeks. One prime minister of the Kejriwal government says, that lockdown might reduce the rate of infection in the country In fact, the fact that there was no lockdown for the whole country in our country It had happened before Modi's lockdown in Delhi. There would've been a Assembly seat in Delhi. Will all this happen once again? The situation these days... They say there's no smoke without fire.. And Uddhav Thakare has started to light a fire about getting the lockdown implemented. Now, what happens next? The most important thing is that whether a lockdown is implemented or not, what does their opinion say? For me it is like an expert saying, which is connected in medical services. If you have seen the doctor of A Dr. Gularia had first said that there will be a huge spike in aftereffects of July That means, the number of coronavirus patients will go up in numbers That threat remains The medical superintendent from Sabdar Jang Hospital Balvinder Singh has also clearly stated Lockdown made it important in the current situation in Delhi, the whole lockdown period. The lockdown period is not an extended period as its totally un-movement. It is a no-make movement as the whole lockdown should be as normal as Lock-down 1 to improve Delhi's overall situation. Even government officials, experts from all over the country need to accept that as the situation is the condition for all the countries. So, let's look at this, the govt. experts believe that we should ensure that lockdown continues even in Mumbai and Delhi. And this is the main reason behind these reports from several countries, and that is what I can tell you, that people have started telling me that it might happen in 1-2 weeks, 1-4 month for most of the nations People are saying two weeks will do some say a month, another 40 days but the fact that one thing is certain that the situation of Dubai and Mumbai are very bad.
